beats.label: S1 · Rue comes home using
beats.text: Fresh out of rehab, Rue immediately buys from her dealer Fezco. She has no intention of staying clean and hides it from her mother and sister Gia.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes Rue's baseline lie that every relationship this season is built on.

beats.label: S1 · The motel hookup collides
beats.text: New girl Jules sleeps with an older man from an app. That man is Cal Jacobs — father of Nate, the quarterback who harasses Jules at a party that same night.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The Cal–Jules collision is the engine of every Jacobs plot that follows.

beats.label: S1 · Rue and Jules fall in
beats.text: Rue latches onto Jules and the two become inseparable, then start kissing. Rue's sobriety becomes wholly dependent on the relationship holding together.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Frames Rue's recovery as contingent on Jules — the fragility that snaps at season's end.

beats.label: S1 · Nate becomes ShyGuy118
beats.text: Nate catfishes Jules as "Tyler", then reveals himself and blackmails her into silence about his father using nudes she sent. Jules is trapped between the Jacobs men.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up Nate's leverage over Jules and the flash drive fight that dominates next season.

beats.label: S1 · Nate frames Tyler, chokes Maddy
beats.text: Nate beats Tyler and coerces both him and Jules into naming Tyler as Maddy's attacker, burying his own assault on Maddy. Maddy takes him back anyway.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Shows Nate weaponising people around him and the toxic Maddy loop that persists.

beats.label: S1 · Cassie's abortion, McKay's exit
beats.text: Cassie gets pregnant by McKay, who pushes for an abortion after being brutally hazed. She goes through with it; the relationship quietly ends.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Leaves Cassie unmoored and emotionally raw — the precondition for the Nate affair.

beats.label: S1 · Jules leaves, Rue relapses
beats.text: Jules and Rue plan to run away together; Rue backs out at the station and Jules boards the train alone. Rue goes home and gets high in a hallucinatory spiral.
beats.whyLoadBearing: This is the state we open S2 in — Rue using again and Jules gone.

cliffhanger.text: Rue is high and alone after Jules leaves her at the train station. Maddy has stolen the sex tape of Cal and Jules, and Nate has just been publicly humiliated by his father — the Jacobs household is a live wire.
questions: How far will Rue fall now that Jules is gone?
What will Maddy do with the tape of Cal and Jules?
Where do Nate and Cal go after Nate tried to physically fight his father?

characters.name: Rue Bennett
characters.line: Sixteen, newly relapsed, narrating the show; her sobriety was tethered to Jules and Jules just left.

characters.name: Jules Vaughn
characters.line: New in town, trans, in love with Rue but overwhelmed by her; on a train to the city having chosen herself over the relationship.

characters.name: Nate Jacobs
characters.line: Star quarterback, violent and closeted-adjacent; broken up with Maddy, exposed to his father, and holds nudes of Jules as leverage.

characters.name: Cal Jacobs
characters.line: Nate's father, a closeted man who films sex with young men and trans women; slept with underage Jules and knows Nate knows.

characters.name: Maddy Perez
characters.line: Nate's ex who took him back after he choked her at the carnival; secretly has the disc of Cal and Jules.

characters.name: Cassie Howard
characters.line: Recently had an abortion and split from McKay; craves male attention and is quietly falling apart.

characters.name: Fezco O'Neill
characters.line: Rue's dealer and closest protector; loves her enough to cut her off, and has just robbed his supplier's supplier to survive.

characters.name: Lexi Howard
characters.line: Cassie's younger sister, Rue's oldest friend; a quiet observer of everyone else's chaos.

characters.name: Kat Hernandez
characters.line: Reinvented herself as a dominatrix camgirl after her sex tape leaked; softening back toward Ethan by the finale.

beats.label: S2 · Ashtray kills Mouse
beats.text: Fezco's younger brother Ashtray hammers the supplier Mouse to death, freeing Fez from that debt but chaining both of them to a murder cover-up.
beats.whyLoadBearing: This killing is why the SWAT raid happens in the finale.

beats.label: S2 · Cassie and Nate, in secret
beats.text: On New Year's, Cassie and Nate have bathroom sex and begin a secret affair behind Maddy's back. Cassie's whole life narrows to hiding it.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The betrayal that detonates the friend group at Lexi's play.

beats.label: S2 · Rue's Laurie debt
beats.text: Rue convinces the dealer Laurie to front her a suitcase of drugs to sell. Instead she and Elliot get high on it, leaving Rue owing a dangerous woman a fortune.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Laurie is the threat Rue is still running from three years later.

beats.label: S2 · The intervention blows up
beats.text: Rue's mother finds the drugs; Jules and Elliot join the intervention. Rue erupts, outs Cassie and Nate to Maddy, and flees into a night of theft and withdrawal.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Detonates the Cassie/Maddy/Nate triangle and marks Rue's rock bottom.

beats.label: S2 · Nate takes the tape from Maddy
beats.text: Nate holds Maddy at gunpoint for the disc of Cal and Jules, then gives it to Jules as an apology. Cal's leverage over Nate flips into Nate's leverage over Cal.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up Nate turning his father in and the final Jacobs implosion.

beats.label: S2 · Lexi's play, Our Life
beats.text: Lexi stages a play about everyone in her life. Cassie rushes the stage, Maddy attacks her backstage, and Nate storms out and dumps Cassie for good.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Publicly ends every major friendship of the season in one night.

beats.label: S2 · The raid, and Cal arrested
beats.text: A SWAT team kills Ashtray and arrests a wounded Fez. That same night Nate gives police Cal's video archive, and Cal is taken away.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes Ashtray, Fez, and Cal from the board simultaneously.

cliffhanger.text: Ashtray is dead, Fezco is under arrest, Cal is in custody, and the Cassie–Maddy–Nate friendship is finished. Rue is tentatively sober but Jules is standing alone crying after Rue walked away from her in silence.
questions: Can Rue actually stay sober, and does she still owe Laurie?
What happens to Fezco now that Ashtray is gone and he's facing charges?
Is there anything left between Rue and Jules?

characters.name: Rue Bennett
characters.line: Cratered through withdrawal and betrayal, ended the school year sober; still owes Laurie an enormous drug debt.

characters.name: Jules Vaughn
characters.line: Back with Rue, then not; slept with Elliot, told Rue she loves her, and got walked away from at the play.

characters.name: Cassie Howard
characters.line: Publicly outed as Nate's mistress and dumped by him; humiliated at Lexi's play and warned by Maddy that the worst is coming.

characters.name: Maddy Perez
characters.line: Definitively done with Nate after learning about Cassie; attacked Cassie backstage at the play.

characters.name: Nate Jacobs
characters.line: Broke up with Cassie, gave Jules the tape as an apology, and turned his own father in to the police using the flash drive of Cal's videos.

characters.name: Cal Jacobs
characters.line: Arrested after Nate handed his sex-tape archive to police; publicly disgraced.

characters.name: Lexi Howard
characters.line: Wrote and staged "Our Life", a play exposing everyone she loves; the closest thing to a moral centre the group has left.

characters.name: Fezco O'Neill
characters.line: Arrested and wounded in the raid triggered by Custer's wire; Ashtray, the only family he had left, is dead.

characters.name: Laurie
characters.line: The soft-spoken dealer Rue owes; drugged and bathed Rue and implied she would collect through prostitution.

beats.label: S3 · Five years on, Rue on the run
beats.text: Rue is a drug mule for Laurie, still trying to work off her debt. She crosses back into the US and gravitates toward strip-club boss Alamo Brown for a way out.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the new premise: Rue between two dealers who hate each other.

beats.label: S3 · Cassie's OnlyFans, Nate's debt
beats.text: Cassie and Nate are engaged and broke; she launches an OnlyFans to fund the wedding while Nate hides a spiralling debt to loan shark Naz.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The money hole that drives Cassie's career and Nate's dismemberment.

beats.label: S3 · Wedding, and Paladin
beats.text: Alamo and Laurie escalate a pig-and-cockatoo feud while Rue attends Cassie and Nate's wedding. That night, Naz's men beat Nate at home and take a toe.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Launches both the Alamo/Laurie war and Nate's terminal downward slide.

beats.label: S3 · Rue flips for the DEA
beats.text: Pulled over with drugs, Rue turns informant against Laurie. She wears a wire inside Alamo's world while pretending to help him get revenge.
beats.whyLoadBearing: This double game is what gets her killed.

beats.label: S3 · Maddy and Cassie, back-to-back
beats.text: Maddy manages Cassie's OnlyFans and steers her toward influencer Brandon Fontaine. Their reconciliation runs entirely on Cassie's earnings and Nate's mounting debt.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up Maddy sleeping with Alamo to save Cassie later.

beats.label: S3 · Nate dies, Alamo kills Naz
beats.text: Naz buries Nate alive and takes Cassie hostage. Maddy seduces Alamo for ransom money; he kills Naz and frees Cassie, but Nate is already dead from a snakebite.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes Nate and puts Maddy and Cassie in Alamo's debt.

beats.label: S3 · Rue dies, Ali kills Alamo
beats.text: Laurie hangs herself as her operation falls; Alamo hands Rue fentanyl-laced pills that kill her. Ali walks into Alamo's club and, with Bishop's help, shoots him dead.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The closing image of the show: Rue gone, Ali choosing violence for her.

cliffhanger.text: Rue is dead of an overdose Alamo arranged, Nate is dead in the ground, Laurie has hanged herself, and Ali has shot Alamo in his own club. Cassie, Maddy and Jules are left to figure out what a life without any of them looks like.
questions: What happens to Cassie and Maddy now that they've inherited Nate's house together?
Does Ali face consequences for killing Alamo?
Where does Jules go, alone, after painting Rue's portrait?

characters.name: Rue Bennett
characters.line: Died of a fentanyl overdose delivered by Alamo; appears to Ali in a final vision.

characters.name: Ali Muhammad
characters.line: Rue's sponsor turned avenger; killed Alamo and travelled to Texas to pray with the family Rue met crossing the border.

characters.name: Alamo Brown
characters.line: Strip-club mogul and Rue's second boss; killed Naz to save Cassie, then killed Rue, then was killed by Ali.

characters.name: Laurie
characters.line: The dealer Rue owed; hanged herself as the DEA closed in on her operation.

characters.name: Nate Jacobs
characters.line: Buried alive by loan shark Naz over unpaid debts; dug up dead from a rattlesnake bite.

characters.name: Cassie Howard
characters.line: Widowed the day of her rescue; plans to run an influencer business out of Nate's house with Maddy.

characters.name: Maddy Perez
characters.line: Slept with Alamo to save Cassie and now owes him; leaves the strip club with his lieutenant Bishop.

characters.name: Jules Vaughn
characters.line: Sugar-dating a plastic surgeon named Ellis; painting Rue's portrait alone.

characters.name: Lexi Howard
characters.line: Working as a TV production assistant; refused to join Cassie and Maddy's new venture.
